Carrie Sloane has a pale appearance. She carries a noticeably melancholy demeanor.

## History

Carrie Sloane was present at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Young People's [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) meeting when members learned that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) planned to rent his fence for advertisements. She later attended the farewell party hosted by the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before their departure for college.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P2](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIX.
